services.desc: Our Guided Sightseeing Charter Boat is a restored, classic NW, Grandy Boat Co. built charter boat “RIVIERA” that was built on Lake Union in Seattle in 1964! “RIVIERA” is a licensed passenger vessel, certified by the US Coast Guard for up to 34 passengers plus our captain and one crew. services.name: Riviera Cruises
services.desc: A captivating sunset cruise through the calm waters and intimate passages among South Sound islands and exclusive bays, under bridges grand and small. Gig Harbor, Narrows Bridges, Point Fosdick, Cromwell, Wollochet Bay, Fox Island, Fox Island Bridge and Henderson Bay then we head back in the twilight. Bring a jacket.
